# x402interop

> Open-source cross-chain facilitator, scheme family, and discovery layer for x402. Lets an agent pay on its own chain while the seller is paid on a different chain, using NEAR Intents for settlement. Status: design and early build; API shapes are drafts.

## Get Started
- [Introduction](/intro): what x402interop does and who it is for
- [Overview](/concept/overview): problem, solution, payment paths
- [Quickstart](/guides/quickstart): 5-minute end-to-end cross-chain payment

## Concepts
- [Schemes](/concept/schemes): x402interop-* family + exact/upto/auth-capture/batch-settlement
- [Payment paths](/concept/payment-paths): deposit_address, intents_balance, lightning_topup
- [Wire format](/concept/wire-format): PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → PAYMENT-REQUIRED → PAYMENT-RESPONSE

- [Seller integration](/guides/seller): protect HTTP routes, delivery modes, discovery

- [Live canary](/guides/live-canary): quote, send, poll 1Click swaps
